ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are three black dots in the figure representing three-phase conductors. a is located at the lower left, b is located at the lower right, and c is located above. The three are connected by line segments to form a triangle; the bottom side is labeled D_ab, the right side is labeled D_bc, and the left side is labeled D_ca. Reasoning: The problem gives a three-phase balanced system, frequency f = 50 Hz, and the conductors are located at the vertices of an equilateral triangle, so D_ab = D_bc = D_ca = 1 m. The positive-sequence equivalent geometric mean distance GMD = (D_ab D_bc D_ca)^(1/3) = (1×1×1)^(1/3) = 1 m. The GMR of each conductor is 0.01 m. When ground effects are ignored and resistance is ignored, the positive-sequence inductance is L_1 = 2×10^-7 ln(GMD/GMR) H/m = 2×10^-7 ln(1/0.01) = 2×10^-7 ln(100) H/m. ln(100) = 4.60517, so L_1 = 9.21034×10^-7 H/m. The positive-sequence reactance per kilometer X_1 = 2πfL_1×1000 = 2π×50×9.21034×10^-7×1000 = 0.28935 Ω/km. Rounded to three decimal places, it is 0.289 Ω/km.
